flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Senate control moved slightly toward the Democrats, who remain the favoured party. The Democrats Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]] and Troy Jackson in [[Maine]] both gained ground, with the Kansas move sharp and the Maine move moderate, and the market treats each as a predicted flip. In [[Florida]], the Republican Ashley Moody's chances slipped by a sizable amount.
summaries.governor: The biggest move in Polymarket's governor odds came in [[Vermont]], where the chances of the Republican, Phil Scott, fell sharply. In [[Texas]], the market also cut the Republican Greg Abbott's chances by a sizable amount, while in [[Oregon]] the Democrat Tina Kotek gained a moderate amount of ground.
summaries.house: The biggest move came in [[TX-23 (Del Rio & Eagle Pass)]], where the Republican Brandon Herrera saw a moderate drop in the market's odds for their chances. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], the Democrat Cait Conley gained slight ground in a race the market sees as a predicted flip. The Republican Brad Knott in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]] also slipped a little in the Polymarket odds.
